titulo: DEVO v2 — Casa, sala com profundidade (dia)
prompt: Painted visual novel and RPG background, dark gothic fantasy, highly detailed, cinematic, painterly brushwork with crisp edges. Interior of the Record's small old townhouse living room seen from a high three-quarter camera, the dark herringbone wooden floor clearly visible in perspective and empty in the middle so characters can walk on it, strong depth in three layers. Foreground: a heavy amethyst velvet curtain edge and a tall brass candelabra cut by the frame on the left, slightly out of focus. Middle: a worn amethyst velvet armchair and a round side table with a small brass clock and a stack of black cards, a patterned violet rug. Back wall: an arched wooden front door, a tall gothic window with leaded glass, a black marble fireplace with a gilded mantel clock, a tall bookcase crammed with old books, a small writing desk with a lamp, framed old portraits in shadow. DAY: soft late-morning sunlight pouring through the gothic window in a wide warm shaft across the floor with floating dust, the fireplace cold with grey ash, candles unlit, pale lilac and warm cream light on the walls, soft cool shadows, a few dried roses on the desk. Palette: warm ivory, soft lilac, amethyst velvet, polished wood, a touch of champagne gold. No people, no text, no letters, no watermark.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
